images.caption: The Alex Theatre was built in 1925 and is located at located at 216 North Brand Boulevard in Glendale, California. Originally was named the " Alexander"  after Alexander Langley, the son of C.L. Langley, owner of the West Coast chain that included the Raymond Theater in Pasadena. It featured vaudeville performances, plays and silent movies on a single screen. It was added to the National Register of Historic Places on February 16, 1996 reference #96000102
